title: MLV Studio — approve a composition
question: Three compositions in the Calibrated Grey Field. Which should the sketch build from? Use steer to combine (e.g. 'comp 1 layout, comp 2 hover card and junction glyphs, comp 3 as the stimulus-lab screen').

options.label: Three-rail workspace
options.thesis: Library rail, centred stimulus window, measurement rail, gamma ramp + histogram drawer.
options.viewport: Persistent rails on both sides; drawer with display gamma ramp and orientation histogram.
options.risk: Rails eat canvas width; the gamma ramp is decorative unless it reflects the actual display calibration.

options.label: Canvas-dominant
options.thesis: The stimulus owns the screen; readout floats at the fixation cursor; library is a filmstrip.
options.viewport: Top bar with layer switch (Contours · Junctions · Medial axis · Overlay); junction glyphs on canvas; filmstrip + histogram along the bottom.
options.risk: No home for the dense inspector and feature table except a summoned drawer.

options.label: Stimulus-lab comparison
options.thesis: Two stimulus windows side by side with a matching report under them.
options.viewport: Split controls on top, high/low windows, tolerance table with pass/marginal marks, R call in the footer.
options.risk: This is a mode, not the home screen; the comp also shows two whole drawings rather than complementary subsets, which the build would correct.
